summary:
Strategic IT Infrastructure & Cloud Transformation Leader with global experience in data center operations, hybrid cloud adoption, and enterprise service
delivery. Led large, cross-functional engineering teams across multi-region environments, driving AWS/Azure migrations, operational excellence, and
resilient high-availability architectures. Proven ability to align infrastructure strategy with business growth, strengthen cybersecurity infra and ops, and
standardize governance frameworks across complex global enterprises.
#OldSkool: Seasoned professional in drafting emails, crafting reports, and updating resumes, long before the conceptualization of generative Ai.

bullets: Handled multi-region IT infrastructure operations across global data centers and hybrid cloud environments, ensuring high availability, operational resilience, and SLA-driven service delivery.
Managed enterprise-wide cloud transformation strategy, driving migration of legacy workloads to AWS and Microsoft Azure platforms, optimizing performance, scalability, and total cost of ownership.
Managed large-scale cloud migration programs, including assessment, architecture redesign, workload replat forming, and production cutover for mission-critical logistics systems.
Managed cybersecurity posture and compliance governance, implementing security controls, access frameworks, and audit-ready infrastructure aligned with global regulatory requirements.
Worked on global stakeholder engagement and executive alignment, acting as the bridge between IT operations, regional business heads, and corporate leadership.
Established Disaster Recovery (DR) and Business Continuity (BCP) frameworks, conducting failover testing, resilience drills, and high-availability architecture validation.
Operated hybrid and multi-cloud adoption, integrating on-prem data centers with AWS and Azure ecosystems to enhance scalability, performance, and geographic redundancy.
Established centralized Global Infrastructure Management Framework, standardizing operational policies, patch management, asset lifecycle, and performance monitoring across regions.
Led Infrastructure cost optimization initiatives across data centers and cloud platforms, improving utilization, rightsizing workloads, and reducing operational expenditure.
Strengthened vendor management and strategic partnerships, negotiating SLAs and driving accountability across cloud, telecom, and managed service providers.
Drove infrastructure modernization initiatives including virtualization expansion, network segmentation, identity governance, and zero-trust- aligned access controls.
Senior Service Delivery Manager (Cloud & Applications) Canon CANON MEDICAL SYSTEMS EUROPE B.V.

Led and managed a 28-member cross-functional software engineering team at Canon Medical Systems Europe B.V., overseeing operations, service delivery, and performance governance across enterprise platforms.

Owned end-to-end delivery and operational stability across Service, Salesforce, Finance, Logistics, OBIEE, Fusion, Reporting, MyAnalytics, and Integration platforms, ensuring SLA adherence and business continuity across EU operations.
Planned, created, and standardized the division-wide reporting governance framework, consolidating fragmented reporting streams into a unified, structured executive reporting model.
Implemented KPI dashboards and operational metrics across Salesforce-heavy environments, improving transparency across Sales, Service, and Logistics functions.
Directed multi-system integrations between Salesforce, Oracle Fusion, Finance, and Logistics platforms, improving data accuracy and cross- functional visibility.
Established structured incidents, change, and release governance across distributed teams, enhancing delivery predictability and reducing operational risk.
Acted as the primary escalation and stakeholder interface for business leadership, aligning IT operations with commercial, service, and financial objectives.
High Touch Operations Manager : HTOM (Data Centre Managed Services: Enterprise, BFSI, Service Provider, Oil & Gas, Healthcare, NBFI) cisco CISCO

Delivered end-to-end Cisco HTOM managed services for large enterprise, telecom, BFSI, and healthcare clients including TCS, HCL, Infosys, HDFC Bank, JPMorgan, NSE, and Cerner, supporting multi-site Tier III/IV data center environments.
Led Greenfield Data Center deployments, including rack-level design validation, Cisco Nexus & UCS stack implementation, SAN integration, and production cutover with zero business disruption.
Managed 24x7 ongoing DC operations covering incident, problem, change, and capacity management across core routing, switching, firewall, load balancers, and virtualization layers.

Data Center refresh & upgrade programs (hardware lifecycle, OS upgrades, firmware standardization, migration to new Cisco Nexus platforms), reducing technical debt and improving availability SLA compliance.
Coordinated with cross-functional teams for DC consolidation and migration projects, including workload migration, DR drills, failover validation, and performance benchmarking.
Implemented proactive monitoring, root cause analysis, and automation initiatives that improved MTTR, enhanced uptime, and strengthened security posture in regulated BFSI and telecom environments.
Supported high-availability architectures including multi-DC redundancy, active-active designs, and disaster recovery frameworks aligned with client compliance and audit requirements.
Senior IT Operations & Service Delivery Manager

Led a 60-member multi-disciplinary cloud operations team at XcellHost Cloud Services, overseeing Windows Operations, Cloud Security Servicac Windows Deployment, Network Engineering, Exchange Administration, Database Management, Linux Operations, and shared infrastructure services.
Owned end-to-end cloud infrastructure operations and service delivery, ensuring 24x7 availability, SLA compliance, and performance optimization across hosted enterprise environments.
Directed large-scale Windows server deployments, Active Directory architecture, virtualization platforms, and infrastructure lifecycle management, supporting multi-tenant cloud customers.
Governed enterprise network operations, including routing, switching, firewall management, VPNs, and secure multi-site connectivity across hosted environments.
Oversaw Exchange environments, database platforms (SQL/other), and Linux server estates, ensuring high availability, backup integrity, disaster recovery readiness, and patch governance.
Implemented structured ITIL-based incident, problem, and change management frameworks, significantly improving MTTR, operational discipline, and audit readiness.
Standardized reporting, operational KPIs, and performance dashboards across all technical verticals, bringing visibility and accountability to cross-functional cloud teams.
